title: Reading 2:30 as Half Past
description: Seeing why the clock position at 2:30 is exactly half of the way around the hour.
narration_lines: What does 2:30 mean as a fraction of the hour?
Look at where the minute hand sits on the clock face.
It's gone 30 out of the 60 minutes in the hour.
30 out of 60 simplifies to one half -- that's why we call it half past.

params.hook: What does 2:30 mean as a fraction?
params.footnote: half past = 1/2 of the way around the clock
